explanation: Faithful negative resolution. The formal statement denies that every lacunary sequence that is strongly complete (every tail is complete, equivalent to A∖B complete for finite B) and becomes incomplete when infinitely many terms are removed must have a_{n+1}/a_n → φ. The page reports a counterexample (GPT Pro / Price) with ratios ≥ 6/5 and two distinct subsequential limits. Lacunarity is required only eventually, a slightly weaker hypothesis than the page's 'for all n', which makes the negation slightly easier. The counterexample satisfies the stronger version anyway, so this is harmless.
